usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.line: Armor (Any Light, Medium, or Heavy), Rare (+1), Very Rare (+2), or Legendary (+3)
srd.text:
_Armor (Any Light, Medium, or Heavy), Rare (+1), Very Rare (+2), or Legendary (+3)_

You have a bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.
